answer: In this PoA design, every bonded identity leaves an auditable thread. When k identities coordinate equivocation, correlated evidence triggers pairwise slashing, making aggregate penalties grow as O(k^2), rather than merely with the number of signatures. Detection of a nebula of aliases applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss; asymmetric depreciation further reduces the recovery value of slashed collateral. Thus, the tide of apparent cheap identities cannot hide the escalating cost of controlling a sybil swarm.
